profiles.name: Fadhlina Sidek
profiles.description: Fadhlina Sidek is Minister of Education. She represents Nibong Tebal, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. She is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

profiles.name: Aaron Ago Dagang
profiles.description: Aaron Ago Dagang is Minister of National Unity. He represents Kanowit, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Rakyat Sarawak (PRS).

milestones.title: Include Sabah’s identity in the new Year One and Form One curriculum
milestones.description: Fadhlina said elements of Sabah’s identity would be included in the new Year One and Form One curriculum from the 2027 academic session.
milestones.progress_note: The statement establishes an agreed curriculum commitment following the MA63 implementation meeting. Delivery in the 2027 school session was not verified. The year-end date marks the target year, not a promised exact day.

milestones.title: Fully replace 416 identified dilapidated schools in Sabah
milestones.description: Fadhlina described a full-replacement programme covering 416 identified dilapidated schools in Sabah.
milestones.progress_note: As reported on 11 September 2026, 245 were fully rebuilt and 63 were under construction. The bar is 245 ÷ 416 × 100 = 58.89%, rounded to 59%. It counts completed school replacements, not expenditure or the later construction stages. No overall deadline was established.

milestones.title: Produce 1,280 certified community mediators by 2030
milestones.description: Aaron set a ministry target of producing 1,280 certified community mediators by 2030 to strengthen local dispute resolution.
milestones.progress_note: The statement establishes the target. A comparable certified-mediator total and target-specific outcome were not verified in this pass. Planned mediation centres are not counted as certified people; status and completion remain unknown.

milestones.title: Raise the annual Active KRT Grant to RM10,000 from 2027
milestones.description: Aaron announced that the annual grant for active Rukun Tetangga areas would rise from RM6,000 to RM10,000 starting in 2027.
milestones.progress_note: This is a future grant-rate commitment. The Budget 2027 announcement is not evidence that recipients have received the higher grant. Outcome and completion remain unknown.

party_parents_added.name: Parti Rakyat Sarawak
party_parents_added.description: A component party of Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS).

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.

missing_fields.completion_percentages: NULL unless a dated metric or transparent calculation is explicitly documented.
missing_fields.additional_milestones: Up to two per person in this initial pass; unimported additional commitments are not_researched_to_completion, not proof none exist.
